description: This Java source file defines the TaskEvents class, which includes static methods for handling various order processing task events such as completing assignments, accepting role assignments, and delegating assignments within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: TaskEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for handling order processing events such as completing assignments, accepting role assignments, and delegating assignments within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: completeAssignment
methods.description: Handles the completion of an assignment task, invoking the 'wfCompleteAssignment' service with necessary parameters, and managing error handling and response result.

methods.name: acceptRoleAssignment
methods.description: Handles a role assignment acceptance event, invoking the appropriate event handler service and managing errors.

methods.name: delegateAndAcceptAssignment
methods.description: Handles delegation and acceptance of assignments by invoking the corresponding service through event handler, with error management.

methods.name: addToOrderRole
methods.description: Adds a user to an order role, invoking 'addOrderRole' service and returning success or failure based on service result.
